name: role_conditioned_transform_equivariance_maskaware_confirm
predecessor: P042 stopped at the frozen pixel gate: 62/320 versus 100 required; no visual judge or training was run
claim: The same controlled color transformation should be equivariant when applied to the color-bearing reference role and invariant when applied to the other requested role.
novelty_boundary: Counterfactual generation, pseudo-target images, and invariance are prior art; the candidate increment is the within-query role-conditioned equivariance/invariance split for multi-reference retrieval and its transfer to a real full gallery.

data.exclude_product_ids_from: P041 fixed visual audit and the complete P042 raw pool
data.selection_order: ascending sha256(P043|query_idx) after exclusion and within-pool product deduplication

stage0_stop_rules: any product overlap with the P041 audit, P042 raw pool, or within the P043 audit
development_rationale: P042 measured a masked intervention with full-image MAE, which confounded manipulation strength with white-background area. P043 prospectively separates spatial support (coverage >= 0.08) from effect strength on that support (masked MAE >= 16/255) on a product-disjoint confirmation pool.
